kapaleeshwarar.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
kapaleeshwarar.hours: Roughly 05:30–12:00 and 16:00–21:30 · check on the day
kapaleeshwarar.tip: Remove shoes before the inner courtyard and keep shoulders and knees covered.

dash_n_splash.name: Dash n Splash (closed)
dash_n_splash.price_text: Closed · do not plan a visit
dash_n_splash.tip: This water park is shut, so skip it and pick another family stop instead.

kishkinta.name: Kishkinta
kishkinta.price_text: Ticket price varies by season · check on the day
kishkinta.hours: Usually around 09:30–18:00 · check on the day
kishkinta.tip: It sits well south of the city, so allow extra travel time and go early to beat the heat.

mgm_dizzee.name: MGM Dizzee World
mgm_dizzee.price_text: Entry plus rides · check on the day
mgm_dizzee.hours: Usually around 10:00–18:00 · check on the day
mgm_dizzee.tip: It is far down the coast road, so plan a full day and carry water and sun hats.

queens_land.name: Queen's Land
queens_land.price_text: Ticket price varies · check on the day
queens_land.tip: Confirm it is open and running rides before you travel out to the western edge of the city.

snow_kingdom.name: Snow Kingdom (Chennai)
snow_kingdom.price_text: Entry plus snow gear · check on the day
snow_kingdom.hours: Usually around 10:00–21:00 · check on the day
snow_kingdom.tip: It is cold inside, so wear socks and long trousers; gear is usually provided.

vgp_universal.name: VGP Universal Kingdom
vgp_universal.price_text: Entry plus rides · check on the day
vgp_universal.hours: Usually around 10:00–18:30 · check on the day
vgp_universal.tip: It is on the coast road near the beach, so pair it with an evening beach walk.

marina_beach.name: Marina Beach
marina_beach.tip: Walk the promenade at sunset and try sundal and murukku from the beach vendors.

san_thome.name: San Thome Basilica
san_thome.hours: Usually around 06:00–20:00 · check on the day
san_thome.tip: It is a short walk from Kapaleeshwarar Temple, so visit both in one morning.

mylapore_walk.name: Mylapore neighbourhood walk
mylapore_walk.tip: Wander the lanes around the temple for flower stalls, filter coffee and old houses.

kapaleeshwarar_market.name: Mylapore flower and vegetable market
kapaleeshwarar_market.tip: Come before 08:00 to see jasmine garlands being strung for the temple.

government_museum.name: Government Museum and National Art Gallery
government_museum.price_text: Small entry fee · check on the day
government_museum.hours: Usually closed Friday · check on the day
government_museum.tip: The bronze gallery is the highlight; allow a couple of hours.

egmore_walk.name: Egmore heritage walk
egmore_walk.tip: Look for the colonial-era buildings around the museum and railway station.

t_nagar_shopping.name: T. Nagar shopping streets
t_nagar_shopping.tip: Go on a weekday; the silk saree shops and Ranganathan Street get very crowded.

anna_salai_walk.name: Anna Salai and Mount Road walk
anna_salai_walk.tip: Walk the main artery for shops and old cinemas, but cross with care in traffic.

south_indian_meal.name: South Indian meal at a local restaurant
south_indian_meal.price_text: Budget to mid-range · check on the day
south_indian_meal.tip: Try a banana-leaf meal at lunch and filter coffee afterwards.

marina_sunset.name: Marina promenade sunset viewpoint
marina_sunset.tip: Arrive about 30 minutes before sunset for a spot on the wall.
